features: Modular camera system: separate camera module + video core linked by a 5 m cable
Camera module options: 4MP WDR pinhole 2688x1520 f3.7 F2.5 (93 deg H FoV) and 5MP WDR fisheye 1920x1920 f1.22 F2.0 (180 deg H/V/D FoV)
WDR Pro 120 dB, up to 30 fps, AdaptiveStream, ePTZ 48x digital zoom (4x IE plug-in, 12x built-in)
simultaneous power redundancy (PoE 802.3af Class 0 + DC 12V), 3 video streams (up to 8 profiles)
two-way full-duplex audio (external mic in / line out, G.711/G.726), five-window motion detection
microSD (SDHC/SDXC up to 1TB) + NAS recording, Verint EdgeVR platform, NDAA Compliant

camera-module dimensions: pinhole Ø24x30 mm (19 g) / pinhole slim 33x32x20 mm (43 g), fisheye Ø24x37 mm (28 g) / fisheye slim 33x32x28 mm (52 g); listed dimensions/weight are the V4445-CORE video core
dimensions_mm: 105 x 84 x 30 (W x D x H)

frigate.notes: Verint ONVIF camera (EdgeVR platform) - RTSP path not published; use go2rtc ONVIF autodiscovery (onvif://{user}:{pass}@{ip}) to resolve the stream URL.

blue_iris.notes: Use Generic ONVIF/RTSP; discover the stream path.
